title: Warm cumin lamb, spinach and radish salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or basic dairy: potatoes, onion, lamb, yoghurt, garlic, spinach, radishes, lemon, chives and cumin.

supermarket.reason: Lamb neck fillet, baby spinach, radishes and Greek yoghurt are everyday Tesco lines at ordinary prices for a family dinner.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, bowls, knife and grater, and the technique is simple roasting and tossing.

works.reason: Halved new potatoes get 35 minutes at 220°C, neck fillet roasted for 20 minutes comes out pink, and 500g lamb with 750g potatoes and 200g spinach is right for four.

honest_times.reason: 20 minutes covers halving potatoes, slicing onion, radishes and lamb and making the dressing, and 40 minutes cook fits the 15 plus 20 minutes roasting and the rest.

honest_ingredients.reason: Lamb neck fillet matches lamb-neck, every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm salad of spinach, radishes, new potatoes and lamb suits mid-April, and the spinach forms the base of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Roast lamb, potatoes, greens and a yoghurt dressing make a substantial, balanced family dinner.
